title: Make a pizza
intro: In this short study you will make a virtual pizza by dragging toppings onto it, and then answer a few questions about it and about yourself. Nothing is eaten.
It takes about 10 minutes and needs a desktop or laptop computer with a mouse or trackpad. Your answers are stored without your name.
